title: Query returns unavailable when active rent exists for requested period
gherkin:
Feature: Availability Query Correctness
  Scenario: Item marked unavailable during active rent period
    Given an item with ID "ITEM-001"
    And an active rent record for "ITEM-001" from "2024-01-15" to "2024-01-20"
    When I query availability for "ITEM-001" from "2024-01-15" to "2024-01-20"
    Then the system returns availability status "UNAVAILABLE"
    And the response includes the blocking rent record ID
rationale: Validates core requirement that availability queries reflect current rent status. System must calculate availability based on existing rent records and prevent overlapping rentals by marking items unavailable during active rent periods.
usedContextItems: System shall calculate item availability based on existing rent records|System shall return availability status indicating whether item is available or unavailable for requested period|System shall ensure availability queries reflect latest rent and item status information at query time
